_comment: SWDev guard config for TangramPlaytime (intake path C, SWDev v0.20, scaffolded 2026-10-08 — the TangramNoAds re-run). Read by the PreToolUse guard hook, the bash approver, trace-check, plan-check, wo-metrics and the verifier runner. The spec is the SwReqCollector collection in Requirements/ (locked 2026-10-01, v1.1): every locked REQ of every level is Contract, so the locked REQ files, the feature tree, the types and the change deltas are denied to the build side — a change is a chg-draft in capture-outbox/ (never a write into the collection). architecture.md and owner-evidence.md are the owner's. At G2 add the governed contract files (puzzle format / IPuzzleLibrary → locked; progress store contracts, kernel value types, ADRs → notify) and re-freeze. Never govern Requirements/views/**, sources.md, evidence/ or reviews/ (the G1 review is written there in the capture side's format).
_comment_contract_paths: G2 (2026-10-11): tiers mirror architecture.md §4 — IPuzzleLibrary + the puzzle schema locked (a format change is a capture-side CHG), ILockEngine / IProgressStore / the contract types notify (logged contract-delta, summarized at WO close).
_comment_hard_stop_paths: None at P1. The manifest's no-permission / no-network rules (owner rule 1, REQ-001/010) are a verifier at every WO close, not a path block.
_comment_unlocked: Emptied at the G2 freeze 2026-10-11 (the P2 authoring window for architecture.md is closed; decisions.md row 4 of that date).
_comment_benign_roots: The Android SDK (adb, emulator, platform-tools) and Android Studio's JDK (jbr) — reads and writes there never prompt. From the v1 run's shell history; adjust if the machine differs.
_comment_test_globs: Product tests only, one test tree per module. tools/tests/test_prototype.py are the PROTOTYPE's browser tests (design input DI-1), deliberately not scanned.
_comment_product_globs: WO-005 (decisions.md 2026-10-17 'Product LOC counts the debug source set'): the DEV aid (REQ-046) is product code in play/src/debug, counted by wo-metrics; trace-check does not read this key.
